title: Inverse Alloy Design of Advanced Steels Using Machine Learning
summary: A Bachelor Thesis project that builds an AI-driven inverse alloy design pipeline, generating candidate steel compositions to hit target yield strength and ultimate tensile strength values before filtering them through metallurgical constraints. The pipeline trains and compares SDV's TVAE and CTGAN synthesizers on alloy composition data, reporting an SDV Quality Score of 90.10% to select TVAE as the generator.
evidence: README: 'TVAE was specifically chosen over CTGAN... achieving a highly accurate Synthetic Data Vault (SDV) Quality Score of 90.10%'; requirements.txt: sdv>=1.5.0
